data.name: HandlerNotFound
data.value: No handler registered for request type '{0}'. Ensure it is registered in DI.
data.comment: Exception message when no handler is found for a request type.

data.name: MultipleHandlersFound
data.value: Multiple handlers registered for request type '{0}'. Only one handler is allowed per request.
data.comment: Exception message when more than one handler is registered for a request type.

data.name: ValidationFailed
data.value: Validation failed for request '{0}' with {1} error(s).
data.comment: Message used when validation behaviour short-circuits the pipeline.

data.name: UnhandledException
data.value: An unhandled exception occurred while processing request '{0}'.
data.comment: Message used when exception-handling behaviour catches an unexpected exception.

data.name: UnsupportedPublishStrategy
data.value: Notification publish strategy '{0}' is not supported.
data.comment: Exception message when an unknown NotificationPublishStrategy value is encountered.

data.name: UnsupportedResponseType
data.value: Response type '{0}' is not Result or Result<T> and cannot carry a failure. Ensure this behaviour is only applied to result-returning requests.
data.comment: Exception message when a pipeline behaviour tries to create a failure for a non-Result response type.
